slots.purpose: Hero: an elegant, real and licensed sense of a Baltic wedding in an old town, without depending on one couple's identity.
slots.shot_brief: Licensed photo of a cobbled old-town lane in Tallinn, Riga or Vilnius in soft late-afternoon early-autumn light, with a consenting couple seen from behind or a detail of a bridal bouquet with rue and wildflowers. Wide 3:2 hero with headroom for a title crop. No flags, emblems, political monuments or border scenery. Never AI.

slots.purpose: Show the Latvian mičošana: the bride's wreath or veil giving way to a married woman's headdress.
